设计意图： Long-term trend cycle position weighted by directional efficiency. The trend deviation from SMA200 normalized by ATR20 captures overextended/oversold conditions. Multiplying by directional efficiency (median of absolute close return / intraday range over 10 days) amplifies the signal when price moves are directionally strong and attenuates it on noisy, range-bound days. 🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 sma200：close.滚动窗口(200, min_periods=200).mean()
  5. 计算 tr：pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs(), axis=1).max(axis=1)
  6. 计算 atr20：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 position：(close - sma200) / atr20
  8. 计算 ret_abs：close.pct_change().abs()
  9. 计算 range_：high - low
  10. 计算 range_：range_.clip(lower=1e-8)
  11. 计算 efficiency：ret_abs / range_
  12. 计算 eff_smooth：efficiency.滚动窗口(10).median()
  13. 计算 factor：position * eff_smooth
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_trend_directional_confidence(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] "com"># primary: trend cycle position sma200 = close.rolling(200, min_periods=200).mean() tr = pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() position = (close - sma200) / atr20.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># lightweight modifier: directional efficiency ret_abs = close.pct_change().abs() range_ = high - low range_ = range_.clip(lower=1e-8) efficiency = ret_abs / range_ eff_smooth = efficiency.rolling(10).median() factor = position * eff_smooth df_copy["factor_trend_directional_confidence"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_trend_directional_confidence"]
